metadata.article_title: Participation of workers in management of industries

article.title: Participation of workers in management of industries
article.content:
43AParticipation of workers in management of industries

Article 43A · Part IV
1[The State shall take steps, by suitable legislation or in any other way, to secure the participation of workers in the management of undertakings, establishments or other organisations engaged in any industry.]

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 9 (w.e.f. 3-1-1977).
